# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

But… if you need me to confirm the cancellation, actually I think I’m having second thoughts and I may just keep it. Sorry, I know that’s annoying — I’ve just been changing my mind all morning.

Also, while I have you, I have another order with two t-shirts on it and I can’t remember exactly which ones I bought. Could you tell me which two t-shirts they are, and what material they’re made of?

My name is Sofia Hernandez, and I’m in Seattle, Washington, 98193. I don’t remember which email I used, unfortunately.
